name: Slaty-backed Thornbill
rangeDescription: Mulga areas of central western australia to south-central queensland
description: Small bird with thin pointed bill, uncommon in mulga woodland of arid inland temperate Australia. Brownish gray above, cream-colored below, with dark eye, dark streaking on forecrown, pale lores, pale-tipped dark tail, and chestnut rump, often visible in flight.

name: Gray Catbird
rangeDescription: Southern british columbia to gulf states; winters to west indies and panama
description: Medium-sized songbird with a smooth gray body, black cap, and rusty-red undertail coverts. Sexes alike.

name: Red-bearded Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Unmistakable leaf-green bee-eater of lowland and foothill forests. Namesake “beard” actually goes from the crown all the way down to the belly.

name: Heuglin's Wheatear
rangeDescription: Mauritania to mali, cameroon, sudan, ethiopia, and northwestern kenya
description: A brownish wheatear with a rusty breast. Note the white eyebrow, dark mask, and pale throat.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Gray-headed Warbler
rangeDescription: Cloud forest of coastal mountains of northeastern venezuela
description: Rare and endangered, a bright yellow warbler with gray head, very short white eyebrow, and orange legs. Sexes similar.

name: Multicolored Tanager
rangeDescription: Locally in andes of western colombia
description: Small stunning tanager with unbelievable color pattern: electric cerulean breast and flanks, black belly, green nape and wings, creamy back, golden face and throat, and black and chestnut ear patch. Sexes similar; females and young birds look duller than males.

name: Stripe-breasted Seedeater
rangeDescription: Eastern and southeastern south sudan, ethiopia, and western and central kenya
description: Medium-sized brown, heavily streaked seedeater. Note the streaked underparts and boldly marked face with a streaked crown, white eyebrow, and broad dark brown patch through the eye.

name: Jamaican Vireo
rangeDescription: Lowlands and mountains of jamaica
description: A small inhabitant of thickets in woodlands and scrublands where it feeds by actively searching for insects within tangles; avoids mangroves and well-manicured woodlands that lack dense undergrowth. The Greater Antillean Elaenia shares this species’ wingbars and overall dull coloration, but the elaenia has prominent whitish markings around the eye and is usually found perched upright or flycatching.

name: Madagascar Yellowbrow
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of east-central madagascar
description: Medium-sized, dark tetraka with pale yellow underparts and a wide eye-stripe. Madagascar endemic of middle- and high-elevation rainforest.

name: Chinese Pond-Heron
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern asia; winters to greater sundas
description: Often mistaken for an egret in flight due to its all-white wings, but the dark head separates it from any egret. This medium-sized heron is found across many different marshy habitats.

name: Moheli Brush-Warbler
rangeDescription: Forest of mohéli (comoros)
description: A medium-sized yellowish-brown bird with a long tail. Endemic to the island of Moheli in the Comoros.

name: Helmeted Pygmy-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, and northern amazonian brazil
description: Tiny flycatcher; common and widespread, but heard far more often than seen. When seen well, note pale eye and elongated crown feathers, giving this bird a hammer-headed appearance.

name: Seychelles Sunbird
rangeDescription: Seychelles
description: A drab brown sunbird with a long downcurved bill. Breeding male has a bib of iridescent blue feathers.

name: Rufous-tailed Shama
rangeDescription: Southern thai-malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Stout shama with a broad, black-tipped, orangish tail. Male has a dark gray upper body, small white eyebrow, and orangish rump and belly.

name: Purple-crowned Plovercrest
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina (misiones) to southern brazil
description: Medium-sized charismatic hummingbird with an iridescent green body and short, straight bill. Males have a violet-blue crest and are violet below with light gray flanks.

name: South Georgia Pipit
rangeDescription: Grassland of south georgia island
description: This small streaky buff-brown ground-dweller is the only resident songbird on South Georgia Island, where it inhabits rocky shorelines, offshore islets, inland pools, and stands of tussac grass. Forages actively for invertebrates, running about and flicking its tail.

name: Bornean Green-Magpie
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo
description: Incredibly beautiful; grass-green with black mask, wine-red wings, and pale tertials. Unlike Common Green-Magpie, Bornean has pale eyes and lacks white-tipped dark tertials.

name: Elfin-woods Warbler
rangeDescription: Montane elfin forest of west-central and northeastern puerto rico
description: A medium-sized warbler of moist montane dwarf forests where it feeds actively in dense canopy foliage. It is most readily distinguished from Black-and-white Warbler by the absence of white streaking on its back and the lack of a white eyebrow.

name: Yellow-billed Stork
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa and madagascar
description: Large, mostly white stork with a distinctive yellow bill and bright red facial skin. It is more tied to wetland habitats than most other storks, and it forages with its bill partially submerged and open, stirring up prey in muddy pools with its feet.

name: Caroline Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Caroline islands (yap including woleai and lamotrek, chuuk, pohnpei including nukuoro, and kosrae)
description: Medium-sized drab brown endemic of Micronesia’s Caroline Islands, where it inhabits a range of habitats, from native forest to degraded coastal scrub and patches of tall grass. Capable of persisting on even tiny coral atolls if there is sufficient vegetation.
